Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1613769. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities and assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL1613769, standard_value not null, and standard_relation '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
